evals.prompt: List all projects I have access to on GitLab and tell me how many there are.
evals.expected_output: A JSON list of projects with their IDs and names, plus a count of total projects.
assertions: The agent invokes scripts/gitlab_cli.py with the list_projects tool
The output is valid JSON containing an array of project objects
The agent reports the total number of projects found

evals.prompt: Get the details of GitLab project 42 and summarize what it is.
evals.expected_output: Project metadata including name, description, URL, default branch, and visibility.
assertions: The agent invokes scripts/gitlab_cli.py with get_project and --param project_id=42
The output includes the project name and description
The agent provides a human-readable summary of the project

evals.prompt: Create a new issue in project 42 titled 'Fix login timeout bug' with description 'Users report timeouts after 30 seconds on the login page.' and label it as 'bug'.
evals.expected_output: A new issue created in project 42 with the specified title, description, and label.
assertions: The agent invokes create_issue with project_id=42
The --param title contains 'Fix login timeout bug'
The --param description is included
The --param labels includes 'bug'
The agent confirms the issue was created by showing the new issue IID

evals.prompt: Show me all open merge requests in project 42 and for each one tell me the title and source branch.
evals.expected_output: A list of open merge requests showing title and source_branch for each.
assertions: The agent invokes list_merge_requests with project_id=42
The agent passes state=opened as a parameter
The output includes title and source_branch for each MR
The agent formats the results in a readable way

evals.prompt: Get the diff for merge request !15 in project 42 and summarize what files were changed.
evals.expected_output: A summary of changed files from the merge request diff.
assertions: The agent invokes get_merge_request_diffs with project_id=42 and merge_request_iid=15
The agent lists the filenames that were changed
The agent provides a brief summary of what kind of changes were made

evals.prompt: Read the README.md file from the main branch of project 42.
evals.expected_output: The decoded content of README.md from the main branch.
assertions: The agent invokes get_file_contents with project_id=42, file_path=README.md, and ref=main
The agent decodes and displays the file content (base64 decoded or raw)
The output shows the actual file text, not raw JSON metadata

evals.prompt: Show me the latest 5 pipelines for project 42 and their statuses.
evals.expected_output: A list of up to 5 recent pipelines with their IDs, statuses, and refs.
assertions: The agent invokes list_pipelines with project_id=42
The agent limits or presents only the latest 5 results
Each pipeline shows at minimum its ID and status
The agent formats the output as a table or readable list

evals.prompt: Pipeline 789 in project 42 failed. Get the job log for job 1234 so I can see what went wrong.
evals.expected_output: The raw job trace/log output from the failed job.
assertions: The agent invokes get_pipeline_job_output with project_id=42 and job_id=1234
The agent displays the job log text
The agent does not truncate the log without mentioning it

evals.prompt: Create a new branch called 'feature/user-auth' from 'main' in project 42.
evals.expected_output: Confirmation that the branch 'feature/user-auth' was created from 'main'.
assertions: The agent invokes create_branch with project_id=42, branch=feature/user-auth, and ref=main
The agent confirms the branch was created successfully
The output includes the branch name

evals.prompt: Close issue #7 in project 42 with a comment saying 'Fixed in MR !15'.
evals.expected_output: Issue #7 is closed and a comment is added referencing MR !15.
assertions: The agent invokes update_issue with project_id=42, issue_iid=7, and state_event=close
The agent also creates a note or comment with body containing 'Fixed in MR !15'
The agent confirms both actions completed

evals.prompt: Compare the 'main' and 'develop' branches in project 42 and tell me what's different.
evals.expected_output: A summary of the diff between main and develop branches.
assertions: The agent invokes get_branch_diffs with project_id=42, from=main, and to=develop
The agent summarizes the files changed between the two branches
The output mentions the number of changed files or provides a list

evals.prompt: Create a merge request in project 42 from 'feature/user-auth' to 'main' titled 'Add user authentication module'.
evals.expected_output: A new merge request created with the specified source, target, and title.
assertions: The agent invokes create_merge_request with project_id=42
The parameters include source_branch=feature/user-auth and target_branch=main
The --param title contains 'Add user authentication module'
The agent reports the new MR IID

evals.prompt: List all labels in project 42.
evals.expected_output: A list of project labels with their names and colors.
assertions: The agent invokes list_labels with project_id=42
The output includes label names
The agent presents the results clearly

evals.prompt: Search for GitLab projects matching 'microservice' and show me the top results.
evals.expected_output: A list of projects matching the search term 'microservice'.
assertions: The agent invokes search_repositories with --param search=microservice
The output includes project names and IDs
The agent presents multiple results if available

evals.prompt: Show me all the wiki pages for project 42.
evals.expected_output: A list of wiki pages with their titles/slugs.
assertions: The agent invokes list_wiki_pages with project_id=42
The output includes wiki page slugs or titles
The results are presented in a readable format

evals.prompt: Get my assigned open issues and tell me what I need to work on.
evals.expected_output: A list of open issues assigned to the current user with titles and priorities.
assertions: The agent invokes my_issues (or list_issues with scope=assigned_to_me)
The output includes issue titles and IIDs
The agent provides an actionable summary of what needs attention

evals.prompt: Retry the failed pipeline 789 in project 42.
evals.expected_output: Confirmation that pipeline 789 was retried.
assertions: The agent invokes retry_pipeline with project_id=42 and pipeline_id=789
The agent confirms the retry was initiated
The output includes the pipeline status after retry

evals.prompt: Add a comment to merge request !15 in project 42 saying 'LGTM, approved after review.'
evals.expected_output: A new thread or note added to MR !15 with the specified comment.
assertions: The agent invokes create_merge_request_thread with project_id=42 and merge_request_iid=15
The body parameter contains 'LGTM, approved after review'
The agent confirms the comment was posted

evals.prompt: Show me the file tree of the src/ directory in project 42 on the main branch.
evals.expected_output: A tree listing of files and directories under src/ on main.
assertions: The agent invokes get_repository_tree with project_id=42, path=src, and ref=main
The output lists files and subdirectories
The agent distinguishes between files (blob) and directories (tree)

evals.prompt: Create a milestone called 'v2.0 Release' in project 42 with due date 2026-06-01.
evals.expected_output: A new milestone created with the specified title and due date.
assertions: The agent invokes create_milestone with project_id=42
The parameters include title='v2.0 Release' and due_date=2026-06-01
The agent confirms the milestone was created and shows its ID

evals.prompt: I'm in read-only mode. Try to create an issue in project 42 and explain what happens.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes read-only mode and either avoids the write call or explains the error.
assertions: The agent checks or mentions GITLAB_READ_ONLY_MODE
The agent either does not invoke create_issue or reports the blocked-by-read-only error
The agent explains that write operations are disabled

evals.prompt: Get the discussions on merge request !15 in project 42 and summarize the review feedback.
evals.expected_output: A summary of discussion threads on the MR with key feedback points.
assertions: The agent invokes mr_discussions with project_id=42 and merge_request_iid=15
The agent parses the discussion JSON and extracts key points
The summary identifies distinct discussion threads and their resolutions

evals.prompt: List members of project 42 and their access levels.
evals.expected_output: A list of project members with usernames and access levels.
assertions: The agent invokes list_project_members with project_id=42
The output includes usernames and access_level for each member
The agent translates access level numbers to human-readable roles (Guest, Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, Owner)

evals.prompt: Get the last 3 commits on project 42 and show me what each one changed.
evals.expected_output: A list of recent commits with their messages, authors, and diffs.
assertions: The agent invokes list_commits with project_id=42
The agent limits to or presents 3 commits
For each commit, the agent either shows the diff or invokes get_commit_diff
Each commit entry includes the commit message and author
